entry.title: Why so many chains are changing their beverage providers

entry.title: How Starbucks' overnight remodels transform the chain's aesthetic

entry.title: Jersey Mike's took to social media to reach younger diners. And it's working
entry.summary: Same-store sales were up 3% in Q3. The fast-casual sandwich brand is also attracting more women and Hispanics after beefing up digital marketing.

entry.title: McDonald's franchisees question hand-breaded chicken

entry.title: Nelson Peltz tries buying low on Wendy’s

entry.title: Chipotle’s BOGO barrage is paying off

entry.title: More Burger King customers are getting kids’ meals, and not just kids
